SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the M1 -2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 26-A in the area bounded by:

        A line 72.50 feet north of and parallel to East 108* Street, the alley next east of and parallel to

to those of a Cl-2, Neighborhood Commercial District.
